IntelligentTradingSimulator.Tests/Orchestration/E2EFixtures/WholeSharePositionSizer.cs:10
Rounding up can return a quantity that exceeds the budget: a budget of 100 at a unit price of 30 returns 4 shares costing 120, and a budget below one share's price still returns 1. Use decimal.Floor to return only affordable whole shares, and add regression cases for non-exact division and a positive budget below the unit price; the current tests do not expose this defect.
